def score(f, p, hw, w):
    s = 0.0
    s = s + f.log_quantized_work_ratio * w[0]
    s = s + f.split_overhead_fraction * w[1]
    s = s + f.serial_fixup_traffic_ratio * w[2]
    s = s + np.log2(f.operand_tile_traffic_ratio) * w[3]
    s = s + f.resident_block_scarcity * w[4]
    s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[5]
    s = s + f.shared_memory_pressure * w[6]
    s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[7]
    s = s + f.has_spill * w[8]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.spill_traffic_ratio) * w[9]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.edge_waste) * w[10]
    s = s + f.tile_roofline_deficit * w[11]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.instruction_density) * w[12]
    s = s + f.k_tail_waste * w[13]
    s = s + f.parallel_reduction_traffic_fraction * w[14]
    s = s + f.thread_work_granularity_deficit * w[15]
    if p.log_flops >= 33.2131 and p.output_work_per_sm < 234057:
        # split-K sweet spot: log2 K-loop iterations per serial split, interior optimum (quadratic)
        L = np.log2(f.mainloop_iteration_count / (1.0 + f.serial_reduction_dependency * f.mainloop_iteration_count))
        s = s + L * w[16] + np.square(L) * w[17]
    return s
